Package com.example.volt.popup

Class PopupManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.popup.PopupManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
OnPopupDestinationChangedListener, OnPopupViewAddToListListener, OnPopupViewClosedListener, OnPopupViewGoNowListener
public class PopupManager extends Object implements OnPopupViewClosedListener, OnPopupViewGoNowListener, OnPopupViewAddToListListener, OnPopupDestinationChangedListener
PopupManager is a link layer between PopupView, Destination, DestinationCollection and the other managers. Controls opening and closing of PopupViews and tracks the Destinations that they show.

Representation Invariant:

  • destinationPopupViewLeft != null
  • destinationPopupViewRight != null
  • destinationCollection != null
  • currentlyDisplayedDestinationLeft != null iff destinationPopupViewLeft.isOpen()
  • currentlyDisplayedDestinationRight != null iff destinationPopupViewRight.isOpen()
  • At most one popup view is open at a time:
    !(destinationPopupViewLeft.isOpen() && destinationPopupViewRight.isOpen())

Abstraction Function:

PopupManager pm represents a link between PopupView, Destination, DestinationCollection and the other managers such that:
  • pm.destinationPopupViewLeft is the left PopupView
  • pm.destinationPopupViewRight is the right PopupView
  • pm.currentlyDisplayedDestinationLeft is the Destination that's currently being displayed in the left SlidingPopupView.
  • pm.currentlyDisplayedDestinationRight is the Destination that's currently being displayed in the right SlidingPopupView.
  • pm.destinationCollection is the collection of all Destinations.
